title: Verified Commons recordings are imported with complete provenance
description:
As an Apricity curator, I want audio from the selected Wikimedia Commons categories imported with complete credits and license provenance, so that I can use verified material in scores.

Feature: Import licensed Commons audio

Scenario: A category member has a supported license and complete attribution
  Given a direct member is an audio-only file and its Commons page has a supported license and required creator information
  When the Commons collection is imported
  Then Apricity stores the original audio, analyzed sample, normalized attribution, license details, and a revisioned metadata snapshot
  And the sample is available for browsing and scores

Scenario: A file is duplicated across categories
  Given the same Commons file belongs to more than one selected category
  When the categories are imported
  Then one recording and sample are created with all selected category memberships preserved

Scenario: A file has incomplete or unsupported rights metadata
  Given a Commons file lacks a required creator or uses a license Apricity cannot classify
  When its metadata is checked
  Then it is excluded from the production library and listed in the review report

Scenario: An entry is not audio-only
  Given a direct category member is a video container or unsupported media type
  When the category is imported
  Then it is excluded and reported
